name: Test: James tone circuit and a KT88 pair
notes: Not an amp: only for tools/cpp_check.py (C++ against Python), to cover the james style and the KT88. Feedback amount 0.04 or more makes this loop ring at 10 Hz on its own (the two 10 Hz high-passes in the loop turn the phase by 180 degrees there), in Python too; then tiny differences grow with the ringing and the check fails. 0.02 = half of that.
